short: A highly successful Confederate commerce raider that devastated Union shipping during the Civil War.
full:
Secretly built in Birkenhead, England, and launched in 1862, the CSS Alabama was a screw sloop-of-war designed for speed and endurance. Under the command of Captain Raphael Semmes, she never docked at a Southern port, instead undertaking a global raiding voyage that ranged from the Americas to the East Indies.

Over two years, the Alabama captured or burned over sixty Union merchantmen, severely disrupting Northern commerce and drawing United States naval forces away from the blockade. Her career ended in June 1864 when she was challenged and sunk by the heavily armed USS Kearsarge outside the port of Cherbourg, France.
